## Goal
What should exist when this is done, in one or two sentences.

## Done when
- [ ] Concrete, checkable result (e.g. "a permit from today appears as a lead")
- [ ] Docs in `docs/` updated

## Notes
Links, decisions, constraints (build plan step, rules from CLAUDE.md §2 that apply).
